standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice checking the result. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Without being told exactly what to check, the learner is checking the result of their own completed contribution against the real need they identified in the first lesson of this unit, using specific observable evidence rather than a general impression.
safetyNotes: This is an evaluation and reflection task; no new physical task execution happens in this lesson.
materials: learner-local: the learner's original need statement from the first lesson of this unit

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Rate your confidence that the need was genuinely addressed (very / somewhat / not yet), cite one of your two pieces of evidence, and choose: this contribution is done, it needs one more step, or I need to rethink part of the plan.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable. | Honest self-assessment: Confidence rating is consistent with the evidence. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Ask one other household member whether they've noticed the need being addressed, and compare their observation to the learner's own two pieces of evidence.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice checking the result. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: the learner's original need statement from the first lesson of this unit
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: checking the result worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Without being told exactly what to check, the learner is checking the result of their own completed contribution against the real need they identified in the first lesson of this unit, using specific observable evidence rather than a general impression.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact checking the result decision or action.
Model move 2: Quickly recall: what was the original need you named at the start of this unit, before you started planning?
Model move 3: Check your completed contribution against that original need using at least two specific, observable pieces of evidence.
Model check: Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable. | Honest self-assessment: Confidence rating is consistent with the evidence.

resources.title: checking the result action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for checking the result.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: checking the result coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Without being told exactly what to check, the learner is checking the result of their own completed contribution against the real need they identified in the first lesson of this unit, using specific observable evidence rather than a general impression.
Coach direction: Quickly recall: what was the original need you named at the start of this unit, before you started planning?
Learner prompt: Restate the original need.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: checking the result complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Check your completed contribution against that original need using at least two specific, observable pieces of evidence.
Response 1 (t2-p1): State your two pieces of evidence and what each one tells you about whether the need was addressed.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My evidence is specific and observable (something someone else could also check), not just a feeling.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: checking the result minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.

Reflection: Rate your confidence that the need was genuinely addressed (very / somewhat / not yet), cite one of your two pieces of evidence, and choose: this contribution is done, it needs one more step, or I need to rethink part of the plan.
Success checks: Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable. | Honest self-assessment: Confidence rating is consistent with the evidence.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: checking the result supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional checking the result condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable. | Honest self-assessment: Confidence rating is consistent with the evidence..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

resources.purpose: Resolves the lesson's named plan so the learner is never directed to a phantom material.

coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.

guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable.

simulationRoute.title: checking the result — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the checking the result task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Rate your confidence that the need was genuinely addressed (very / somewhat / not yet), cite one of your two pieces of evidence, and choose: this contribution is done, it needs one more step, or I need to rethink part of the plan.
observableCriteria: Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable.
Honest self-assessment: Confidence rating is consistent with the evidence.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Evidence specificity: At least one piece of evidence is specific and observable. | Honest self-assessment: Confidence rating is consistent with the evidence.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
